Closing as a **duplicate of #15811**, which is older, already ruled, already dispatched and already carried by a PR in flight.

**What I got wrong.** I filed this card as an open follow-up asking whether the gate-slot conversion "should be converted, and on whose authority". That question was already answered six days before I asked it: card #15811 carries the maintainer's ruling in comment 5644350409 (2026-09-12T07:02:53Z, decision batch #122 item 2, 「同意」 to `1A·2A·3A·4A·5A`), whose item 1 rules that `EvaluatedExpressionSchema` composes into every evaluated slot the census found — naming the field, option and grid-column `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`, object `visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen`, action `visibleWhen` / `visible` / `ActionConditionInputSchema`, app `visible`, settings visibility and `ui/bulk-action` visibility, 「⛔ By identity on all 36 positions」. #15811 is `pm:dispatched` to os-litant, and PR #18638 (`claude/issue-15811-evaluated-slot-narrowing`, head `70407326463d08f8d0c2e6419037328ea1bf93fd`) implements it.

So this card did not merely duplicate an open question — it re-opened a settled ruling. That is the more serious half of the error and it is the reason this closes rather than being narrowed and kept.

**Scope comparison, since that decides which one closes.** #15811 covers all 36 evaluated declaring positions under a standing ruling; this card covered 21 gate and inline-column slots and proposed three options for a direction already given. This card's scope is a strict subset. #15811 stays open; this one closes.

**What was carried over, so closing loses nothing.** The one measurement here that I did not find stated on #15811 — the declared fault directions, 4 of 21 slots declaring one and disagreeing 3-to-1 (fail-closed at `data/object.zod.ts:1194`, `data/object.zod.ts:1387`, `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts:209`; fail-soft at `data/object.zod.ts:1390`), plus the `system/settings-manifest.zod.ts:424` and `:686` spelling note — is now on #15811 as comment 5728924245, posted as evidence only with no change to that card's labels, assignee or state.

**How the duplicate happened, recorded so the mechanism is visible rather than just the outcome.** The filing protocol has the filer attach dedup words and the triage seat run them. I attached five — `gate predicate`, `visibleWhen`, `ExpressionInputSchema`, `evaluated slot`, `blank predicate` — and did not run them myself. #15811's own title contains `ExpressionInputSchema`, `visibleWhen` and the phrase "`ast`-only or blank-`source` envelope", so three of the five would have hit it on the first query. I also wrote in this card's own dedup section that a zero on those words would not be evidence of no duplicate, which was the right caution aimed at the wrong risk: the words were fine, the omission was running them at all.

Not reopening this under a narrowed scope. If the `settings-manifest` spelling turns out to fall outside #18638's census after all, that belongs on #15811 as a scope note, not as a second card.

Closed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (`Seat: domain:spec#3`) that filed it, 2026-09-18T10:48Z.
